reviews.text: Professional team and excellent service. I recommend them and will use their services again when needed.
They ended up killing my kitten. They performed procedures they shouldn't have done; they seem like interns... very sad.

It was a disgrace. I went to the emergency room at 1 am and the doctor very abruptly dismissed me, telling me to come back in two hours, maybe then he could see the dog. It would cost €95, and the hospital was completely empty. I had to go to Pet 24 in Alferagide where I was welcomed and treated with great professionalism.
Professionalism and friendliness.

It's impossible to get in touch with any of the hospital's three phone numbers, not even the 24-hour emergency number. We've tried at various times and on all numbers since February. This is worrying for a hospital that supposedly has 24-hour emergency services. I even thought it had closed, but to my surprise, when I passed by, they were "working." The administrative staff are mostly unfriendly and arrogant, but now they don't even answer the phone, so you can't even schedule anything. We also took our young cat to the emergency room, and they didn't even check his temperature and sent him home with only a recommendation for deworming... he was sick, with a fever, which we later learned from another doctor. Although there are some competent doctors working here, I don't recommend it. It used to be good. Now, the risk and hassle aren't worth it.
I was very pleasantly surprised. Thank you so much for the 5-star service you provided to my cat. I recommend you 100%.

Edit: Unfortunately, the last time I went there, there was so much indifference towards my cat's health that I never went back. It seemed to me that they were understaffed.

The 24-hour service, the available diagnostic methods, access to specialist doctors, and the kindness and care of the doctors and nurses make me choose this clinic.

We had two situations where my cats needed hospitalization and ongoing treatment, and all the doctors and nurses were very kind. Special thanks to Dr. Odete, Carolina, Frederico, Catarina, and nurse Carla, who was the one we had the most contact with (but they were all very kind).
The staff was highly competent and very friendly. And, given the reality of an unscheduled consultation, with tests and products, it was affordable.
Very bad (

Absolutely irresponsible clinic. We brought our cat in for a procedure, and after it they gave him such a huge dose of anesthesia that he could barely wake up for almost an entire day. We were terrified and had to contact other clinics to save our pet.

The worst part is that the doctors refused to provide full medical records and information about the medications and dosages that were given to our cat. This is completely unacceptable. Pet owners have the right to know what is happening to their animal.

A terrible experience, complete carelessness, and zero responsibility. I would never recommend trusting them with your pets.

Communication issues. Our friends took their cat there, and after a minor procedure, they sent him home without making sure he was well enough to do so. After a lot of stress, we had to go back to the clinic and continue treatment because they didn’t do it right away, and their communication seemed aimed at getting us to leave the clinic quickly so they could collect the payment, rather than resolving the issue.

Very disappointing experience with Hospital Veterinário de Lisboa.

We brought our cat for a routine dental cleaning. Before the procedure, blood tests and a cardiac ultrasound were performed, and we were told there were no concerns regarding anesthesia.

From the beginning, communication and organization were very confusing. We received different arrival and procedure times multiple times. On the day of the procedure, we brought our cat at 14:00 and were told the cleaning would start around 16:30.

At 18:00, after receiving no update, we returned to the clinic ourselves and were told the procedure had only just started. We were finally called around 20:00 to pick him up.

When we picked him up around 20:15, his condition was alarming. During the drive home he urinated on himself multiple times, and once home he became almost completely unresponsive: not eating, not drinking, barely moving, pupils barely reacting to light, and his body temperature was extremely low. A few hours later, his temperature measured approximately 34.5°C.

We called the clinic and were repeatedly told “it’s okay”, but his condition appeared serious enough that we returned to the clinic around 23:00. Even there, his temperature was still around 35°C. Only after insisting did they provide additional warming and reverse part of the anesthesia.

We also requested a simple list of the anesthesia drugs and dosages in case we needed to go to another emergency clinic during the night. This information was refused. We were told to simply leave the cat overnight instead.

To formally document our request, we also sent an email the same night asking for the anesthesia report and medication details. Several days later, we still have not received any response.

After what was supposed to be a routine dental cleaning, our cat needed more than 30 hours before he started drinking water independently again.

For nearly 400€, we expected significantly better communication, transparency, and post-procedure care.

Cost estimate based on an incorrect diagnosis, I almost lost my kitten who had to have emergency surgery at another hospital.
I felt the doctor was afraid I would leave without paying for the emergency consultation, as he didn't allow me to take the kitten with me to wait in the waiting room.
I do not recommend them, I will not return, and I regret trusting you.
I will proceed to formalize my complaint.
I do not recommend them; they didn't even examine my cat and quoted a price of €677.

Spectacular veterinary care in an emergency setting. My public thanks to Dr. Sara for the attention she gave us, for her patience in explaining the treatment and the entire context of my cat's illness. It was very important. I hope to return and continue having my cat's veterinary care at this clinic.

Our dog fractured his humerus. The veterinary orthopedist, João Louro, was very quick with all the necessary surgical procedures, for which he received €2225. In the post-operative period, he didn't explain that our dog would have to be confined while we were away from home – to prevent falls. Our dog fell, and an X-ray showed that one of the titanium plates and screws had come loose, shattering the bone. They immediately sent the information to the orthopedist to determine what could be done to save our dog. Dr. João not only delayed his response and the budget for almost a week, but he also didn't even offer us a word, knowing our dog was in great distress. It was Dr. Inês, the clinical coordinator at HVL, who had to intervene and pressure the orthopedist to respond. Unfortunately, our dog's condition became critical, and we couldn't save him. To João Louro, the alleged orthopedic veterinarian, we leave the following message: veterinary medicine is not a business; the lives of beings who require dignity, sensitivity, and protection depend on it. His conduct with our dog demonstrated not only a lack of ethics but also a lack of humanism. STAY AWAY FROM THIS ORTHOPEDIC SURGEON JOÃO LOURO – HE DOES A TERRIBLE JOB.

We went to this veterinary hospital at night, in an emergency situation, with our dog, after several attempts to contact them by phone using the three numbers provided (two posted on the door and one available on Google), without any response. Concerned about our animal's health, we decided to go to the location in person.
Upon arrival, the veterinarian on duty informed us that she was attending to another patient and that she had no availability or forecast to see us. We understand that, in an emergency situation, there may be capacity limitations.
However, what we consider absolutely unacceptable was the way the whole situation was handled. At no point were we asked about the urgency or the clinical condition of our dog. We were not given any minimal advice, nor was any alternative or referral to another location suggested. The interaction ended without any kind of guidance, leaving us completely helpless.
It is important to emphasize that we were also facing a potentially serious situation, which could involve a risk to life (for example, sudden poisoning). The simple fact that no basic clinical questions were asked or verbal triage attempts were made is deeply concerning, especially considering that this is a hospital that presents itself as a 24-hour emergency service.
We would also like to add that we have previously used this clinic in an emergency context and were exemplarily attended to by Dr. Inês Freitas, an excellent professional, extremely attentive, empathetic and genuinely concerned, both for us and for our dog. This positive experience makes it even more evident that what we experienced on this last visit does not represent the level of care that we know is possible at this clinic, being a clear exception compared to the care we have received in the past.
We left this experience extremely distressed and with a feeling of abandonment at a time of great vulnerability. This is not the level of care expected from an institution whose mission should be the protection of the health and lives of animals.

We had a profoundly negative experience at the Lisbon Veterinary Hospital with our cat Yodgii.
During the 5 days he was hospitalized, there was a clear lack of empathy, information, and communication. If we hadn't called and visited him more than once a day, we simply wouldn't have known what was happening. The only consistent communication was to present new costs, many of them related to procedures that brought no real benefit.

A biopsy was performed to confirm a serious clinical scenario (Large Cell Lymphoma - LGC). While we awaited the result, one of the doctors unethically pressured us to authorize the placement of an orogastric tube and the move to the operating room. We agreed because Yodgii was a member of our family and we wanted to do everything possible (the tube was placed 2 hours before we received the cytology results)!

Two hours after paying a very high amount, we received the report: the diagnosis was incompatible with life. We were then forced to make the most painful decision of all — euthanasia.
That is, Yodgii underwent absolutely unnecessary surgery and suffering just two hours before we learned that there was no chance of recovery.

We were left with the clear feeling that the main focus was money, not the well-being of our animal or respect for our pain. An experience we will never forget, for all the wrong reasons.
First and last time. The receptionist's arrogance and the price I paid for my dog's vet visit are reasons not to return...
Excellent service!
Well located with easy access and parking on the outskirts.

I just want to thank you for what you did for my kitten Mel. 🙏 I have nothing bad to say about anyone or the service. Thank you 🙏
I recommend ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ …

My experience with this clinic was quite negative. The service is disorganized and inattentive, clients are left waiting for long periods without any justification.
My dog ​​underwent surgery which, despite the potential risk of anesthesia, was not a procedure that should, under any circumstances, put his life at risk. A few days later, we returned for a follow-up appointment, where they assured us that he was recovering well. Unfortunately, my dog ​​passed away that same day. It was a devastating situation, aggravated by the lack of communication, empathy and professional rigor demonstrated.
In addition, the final amount charged was much higher than the initially presented budget, even though the problem had already been identified from the beginning. I consider this practice dishonest and unjustifiable.
I deeply regret the way the whole process was conducted. I expected professionalism, transparency and care, but unfortunately that is not what I found.

1 star. Why? The first time I went to this veterinary hospital, I was very well attended to by Dr. Sara Silveira. The second time, I was seen by another veterinarian, and she demonstrated a super arrogant attitude and showed indifference to what I told her.
I was in the consultation room for about 5 minutes and was charged the full amount of the consultation plus medications that were not at all necessary. She did not inspire confidence and, moreover, did not examine my Belgian Malinois Shepherd, who is only 8 weeks old. By this I mean that this indifference resulted in a change of clinic, with this one noticing an allergic reaction in my dog ​​that, had it been detected by the same doctor, my puppy would not be sick now.
I tried to contact the coordination of this veterinary hospital and never succeeded.
I do not recommend this hospital after this episode.
Thank you for your work and attitude! The most polite and friendly staff! Thank you. They saved my dog. I recommend this excellent clinic.

Sick cat with incorrect diagnosis, but no available appointment/time for reassessment today, less than 24 hours after being there. If it were an emergency tomorrow (Sunday), a higher fee would be charged. Lamentable.

I came here with my cat once at night (an emergency) and had to wait almost 1h30m even if there was nobody in line or waiting ahead of me.

Truth must be told that afterwards the service was definitely 5*, but you need to keep in mind that when an animal is suffering and in pain, waiting almost 1h30m is taxing both on the poor thing and also the owner which, in my case, was getting extremely annoyed and even had to knock on the door to "remind you" there was someone waiting.

Please avoid this as your service is otherwise nearly flawless.

Unacceptable experience at the Telheiras Veterinary Hospital – a serious warning to all pet owners

On the afternoon of June 20th, we went to the Telheiras Veterinary Hospital with our dog, Scott, who was in a visibly critical state of health: extremely lethargic, with pronounced abdominal breathing and unable to move normally.

Upon arrival, our dog was immediately taken inside the clinic, without us being allowed to accompany him. We were later informed that he had undergone a physical examination, blood tests, and an X-ray. After this assessment, Scott was handed over to us and sent home with a potassium supplement, under the justification that the probable cause was a parasitic infection.

It is important to emphasize that, in addition to the evident clinical symptoms (altered breathing and extreme prostration), the tests revealed below-normal potassium levels, elevated liver enzymes (ALP), and low platelet levels—data that, in any responsible clinical context, would require urgent and thorough investigation.

Although uncomfortable with the explanation provided, we decided to trust the veterinarian's clinical judgment. However, in the following hours, Scott's condition worsened drastically, to the point where he could no longer stand. Given the seriousness of the situation and the total lack of confidence in the care provided, we chose not to return to this hospital and, instead, took him to the Restelo Veterinary Hospital.

At that hospital, an abdominal ultrasound was immediately performed, which revealed a ruptured spleen with active internal bleeding. Our dog had to undergo an urgent splenectomy. Fortunately, the procedure was successful and saved his life.

The reality is that, by a few mere hours, the outcome could have been tragic. Our dog was literally bleeding out at home, a direct consequence of the clinical negligence and total lack of diagnostic rigor demonstrated by the team at the Telheiras Veterinary Hospital. The absence of an abdominal ultrasound, in such a worrying clinical picture, is, at the very least, incomprehensible.

We are not writing this testimony lightly. We do so with the aim of alerting other pet owners: if your animal is in an emergency situation, avoid this hospital. The approach we experienced was superficial, clinically and ethically unacceptable, and could have cost our dog's life.

Subject: Complaint Regarding Inadequate Medical Prescription and Lack of Critical Information

Dear Sirs/Madams,

I am writing to file a complaint regarding the care provided by your veterinary oncologist to our 13-year-old dog, recently diagnosed with cancer.

From the outset, both my husband and I were very clear about our decision not to resort to chemotherapy. However, despite this explicit indication, we were prescribed Palladia 10mg, a medication clearly intended for chemotherapy purposes. This decision was made without any prior discussion of the associated risks, nor any alternative proposal more compatible with palliative care, which was our objective.

Even more seriously, we were not given any instructions on essential care in handling the medication or our dog's waste (urine, feces, vomit), namely the use of gloves or the separation of spaces, especially considering that we also have a cat at home. My husband, upon picking up the medication, directly questioned the reception about any additional precautions, even mentioning that we had already done some prior research—and yet, he was told that there were no further precautions to take besides using gloves for the pills.

Unfortunately, that same night, after administering Palladia, our dog began urinating blood and showing clear signs of intense pain, which immediately led us to the emergency room of your hospital. The following day, with the symptoms persisting and worsening, we decided to seek a second veterinary hospital, as our confidence in the oncologist was seriously compromised. We had to resort to credit cards to cover the costs, money that should have been channeled towards palliative care—not to correct the damage caused by a medication that should not have been prescribed or administered.

In addition to the emotional impact, we are now left with an extremely expensive medication that will not be used, and enormous frustration at the lack of attention, sensitivity, and responsibility shown in the treatment of a senior animal in the terminal phase of its life.

I arrived for an urgent appointment at 8:50 PM with my dog. The receptionist informed me that the appointment would be more expensive due to the time (starting at 10 PM). The veterinarian was with another patient, and when she finished (around 9:15 PM), she didn't call us. We waited an hour in the reception area without anyone there, without any warning, without any explanation. We realized we were supposed to wait until 10 PM to pay the higher price. In other words, terrible service (or lack thereof). We left (and the reception area remained empty) and I will never return to this clinic.

Frankly, the state of this hospital is deplorable. The medical team is constantly rotating, and there seems to be no communication between the veterinarians, which means that the already short-lived team has to ask the same questions over and over again about the animal.

The prices are absurd, and if they could charge for the oxygen breathed inside the hospital, they would, such is their audacity.

My animal was a patient at this hospital for 8 years, practically monthly, so I have some idea about how the hospital operates, and the conditions have only worsened year after year. I really do not recommend it.

Completely negligent. What they did to my dog ​​was unbelievable. He was admitted in a complex convulsive state. He was poorly medicated, poorly monitored, and misdiagnosed. The dog was prostrate and unresponsive. They wanted to do a CT scan at another partner clinic, and it was even scheduled. We refused and decided to transfer him to the AniCura Hospital, where he was very well received. It was immediately apparent that the dog had a high fever with a pulse over 120 bpm and was poorly medicated, and that if a CT scan were performed, he would die from either the anesthesia or the radiation. The new doctor was incredulous at how incompetent the doctors at HVL were in not even realizing this. The diagnosis is completely different; they were talking about something cerebral, and it turns out to be pulmonary. The incompetence is blatant and serious. A formal complaint will be filed with the veterinary medical association or the appropriate authority. It was too bad. How can they suggest a CT scan when he would die as soon as he entered the machine? In addition to this, they never called to give updates on the dog during its stay in the hospital, they didn't even know how it was doing or that it had a fever, and in the end they were even rude, besides charging high prices for medication and consultations that were never performed. Stay away from this hospital. We will file a complaint!

A purely commercial approach; they exploited my hospitalization, even though I already had a very bad diagnosis. I had to ask the right questions for them to tell me that euthanasia was the best option, otherwise I would have spent 7,000/8,000 euros without any hope. They took advantage of our vulnerability and cornered us. What a shame...

For me, veterinary hospitals were synonymous with death, but my experience at this hospital completely changed my mind. I had to use their emergency services because my cat had stopped eating. The diagnosis was quickly made: an intestinal obstruction. He underwent emergency surgery. Recovery wasn't easy, with anemia along the way, but the team was always helpful and very professional. The ward where the inpatients stay is pleasant, with background music and blankets. They take great care regarding the cat's personality. My kitten is very timid, and they even got him a cardboard box to hide in. A special thank you to Dr. Inês Freitas, who operated on my Kovu and was always available for a panicked owner. She always responded, even on her days off and outside of regular hours. She was undoubtedly an angel to me ❤️ The fact that it's open 24/7 is a huge advantage and a relief. You can trust that you're in good hands 🙌
5estrelas

Terrible....
I didn't like the service at all, both at reception and with the doctors...
First, when they examined my animal, everything was done very poorly. They didn't take his temperature, they removed his ears, they weren't examined, in short.... then they took him inside and you can't even see what they're doing to the animal because they don't let you in.... they immediately gave me quotes that are more expensive than going to CUF with health insurance...
And then, instead of saying that the animal was beyond saving, they said no!!!!
They prescribed medication that I bought there that would make him better... but he didn't get worse and died at home.....
😔
I HATED IT AND I DON'T ADVISE ANYONE TO GO THERE....
A tragedy.......🖤

Terrible service from the receptionist, both in person and by phone. Regarding animal medical care, they don't do in-person check-ups, taking the animal to a secondary room without knowing what they're doing. In my case, the animal had kidney problems, wasn't hospitalized due to the high cost, and went home with medication. I was told it would show considerable improvement, but it died three days later.

My rabbit had surgery and they gave him pain medication equivalent to the weight of an adult Labrador; he had to go back to the hospital for IV fluids. If I hadn't noticed, my rabbit would have died of an overdose.

My dog had immense pain. She was crying out of nowhere. I rushed to the hospital they said I need to make an appointment. I did not know that I need to make an appointment in a hospital…. They were extremely unfriendly at the reception and said only when your dog is dying they can attended her. I waited 3 hours for nothing. No one in the waiting room and they let me wait. Super frustrating. For a dog hospital I would expect much more.  For this client treatment they not even deserve 1 star.
Without a doubt the best veterinary hospital in Lisbon.
Excellent medical staff, excellent service.
They saved Kika 🥰🥰🥰 …

I am eternally grateful to this hospital and its entire team!!!!
Around midnight I had a veterinary emergency where no one in my city (Santarém) would accept him. I called this hospital as a last hope, and they agreed to take care of my best friend. I tell you, from the first contact I felt welcomed with immense kindness and professionalism…
And there I was, being seen at 1 am on a Sunday.
Today he was discharged and is going home, but it could have gone differently if this team hadn't extended a hand to me…
As for the values, what is a life worth? Because my dog's life is worth everything, and there is no money in the world that comes before my four-legged son.
I should also mention that they helped call a taxi because my father, who is unable to call one himself, picked up the dog.
So I am EXTREMELY satisfied and very grateful for what they did for my boy.

A HUGE THANK YOU isn't enough...
Telheiras Veterinary Hospital, you will forever have my gratitude 🙏🏻

On November 22nd, I called HVL (2:11 PM) to ask about the cost of specific food allergy tests, according to the PETCARE insurance. I was informed that the cost would be €112 and that they would give a 5% discount with the insurance. I called again (3:09 PM) to schedule the food allergy tests. On November 27th, the date of the appointment, the doctor examined my dog ​​and prepared a medical history, during which we informed him that we would like to have food allergy tests done, and he mentioned that it could be some kind of allergy. The doctor advised us to have general clinical tests done to understand the dog's health status and that he could then give us more information. An ultrasound was also recommended, but that an appointment would be necessary. The doctor took the dog to another room and we waited. Later, the doctor stated that everything was fine with the tests, and we questioned the fact that our purpose was to have food allergy tests done. The doctor then asked us what price we had been quoted. The doctor stated that these tests did not have that cost, that they would be more expensive, and that they could not match the price given by the receptionist (they also mentioned that they could not verify the facts with the receptionist, as she had undergone surgery and was not at the clinic). Given this, we asked for the final bill, at which point it was discovered that they had performed an X-ray (without our consent). Therefore, I want to express my enormous dissatisfaction with being charged for services I did not request, as I exclusively requested specific tests for food allergies. In addition to these tests not being performed, I was offered a new price for them.
I've had animals treated at this hospital in the past, they were properly diagnosed and medicated, but currently, the quality of medical care is zero.
